title: The Stride
source_seed: The advancing stride (pratyalidha) from the Tara verses
caption_hook: The goddess who crosses the dark water toward you.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, three-quarter-length framing from the reference portrait. The camera pulls back slowly and steadily so She stays the same size in frame as She advances, with the crown and golden sun disc centered and fully framed.
shots.action: She strides toward the viewer through the shallow dark water with the unstoppable force of a warrior, Her gaze hard and fixed, Her weight rolling forward with each step, Her arms swinging with the stride and the skull garland and serpent armbands swaying with it. The water around Her stays calm and dark. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: Pure advance with force: the strongest visual from the dhyana verses, using the motion that worked for Kali.
